_comment: Named batches for the Batch page. Each batch has a 'name' and a 'trades' list; each trade is '<tenor> <pair> <target-level>' (e.g. '3m USDBRL 5.60'). Tenor units: m (months), w (weeks), y (years). Direction is inferred from target vs the horizon forward. Pick a batch on the page, then click 'Run batch'. JSON deploys immediately on Streamlit Cloud (no version bump).
